86:                 and record.owner._worker is worker and token.worker is worker
87:                 and token.phase == "CLEAR_PENDING" and not token.revoked
88:                 and type(token.pending) is object and setup.flush_successes == 3
89:                 and attempt is not None and attempt.token is token.gate
90:                 and attempt.journal is token.journal and attempt.failure is None
91:                 and attempt.handle is setup.created_handle and not attempt.handle.closed
92:                 and not attempt.handle.unconfirmed and token.journal.confirmed_bytes == token.raw
93:                 and token.journal.confirmed_revision == token.journal._stream.write_revision
94:                 and not token.journal._poisoned and not token.journal._stream.poisoned,
95:                 "exact_retired_boundary_before_fixed_interrupt")
